author: gpt-5.6-luna
brief: Phase: implementation (a feature in existing code). Role: developer. Repo kind: a Node.js 24 billing library with a small command-line tool (no dependencies): money values in integer minor units, an invoice module, formatters, tests, CI config and docs. About 35 files. Inspiration (idea only): public money libraries that allocate an amount across parties by ratios without losing or inventing a cent. Build a task where the owner asks to add payment allocation across several open invoices and to split a shared cost by weights, with wrinkles of your own design (largest remainder placement with a documented tie rule, zero and negative weights, currencies with different minor unit sizes, a refusal to allocate across currencies, and an allocation that is stable when the same inputs come in a different order).
